comment: meta-factory's own commissioned lanes (#193). The owner commissioned four instrument lanes on 2026-09-27 -- ledger, questions, pacemakers, methodology -- each owning one template instrument's development and cross-member deployment. They resolve through registry/factories/meta-factory.json's `lanes` (threads 3981 / 4087 / 4223 / 4186), so the derived actor is the role name below. Membership alone would have left them REFUSED: known_actors() reads this file's `actors` list, and authorized_for_event() unions `by_event` onto the core matrix, so a lane declared for membership and absent here for authorization resolves and is then refused BY NAME -- which is the better error and the point of #193. THE SET IS UNIFORM ON PURPOSE: the four lanes do the same kind of work (take a unit, settle it, report), and a differentiated set would encode a distinction no measurement supports. NOT GRANTED, and each for a stated reason: `intake` and `dispatch` are Triage's rows (SKILL.md section 4), `ruling` is the process owner's, `score` is Surveys' measurement duty, `genesis` is bootstrap-only. A lane that files a board item therefore still owes Triage its intake leg -- the delegation of work does not move the routing. EXTENDED 2026-09-28 (#209): fleet-instruments, review-rotation and insights join on the SAME uniform set and for the same reason the original four did — they take a unit, settle it and report. #209 named one lane; the artifact showed three: all three hold LIVE bindings in the Factories chat whose roles appear in no fragment, so the ledger refused every row each one wrote. The set is identical by construction, not by omission. NOT GRANTED, unchanged: `intake` and `dispatch` are Triage's rows (SKILL.md section 4), `ruling` is the process owner's, `score` is Surveys' measurement duty, `genesis` is bootstrap-only.
